advancements.alternative_earlygame.begin: Start your game as normal, for now. You can find all recipes in Recipe Book.
advancements.alternative_earlygame.iron_: Smelt Iron Shard on a campfire to get Iron Nugget
advancements.alternative_earlygame.crush: Craft Crushing Hammer using sticks and cobblestone
advancements.alternative_earlygame.furna: Finally, craft the Furnace as you would do with cobblestone, but using Reinforced Bricks
advancements.alternative_earlygame.reinf: Cook Reinforced Clay on campfire to get Reinforced Bricks
Craft Reinforced Clay on Crafting Table using Iron Nuggets and regular Clay
advancements.alternative_earlygame.campf: Craft a Campfire, using Logs, Sticks and Coal - it will come handy later
advancements.alternative_earlygame.iron_: Crush Raw Iron using Crushing Hammer (combine them in crafting grid) to get Iron Shards
